en.html:
Common sense called her a troublesome guest—and that was not even the beginning of it. Who welcomed someone who could turn a peaceful town into a battlefield in an instant, according to her mood?

Fight, run, or hide and wait for her to leave. One of those was the proper response. To survive a natural disaster, then beg it not to depart—as though throwing away that good fortune—made no sense.

...Precisely why, even while suspecting somebody sheltered Hikaru, I had never felt that suspicion entirely real...

en.html:
...Chachamaru Ashikaga did not look as though she were lying either. Unlike Hikaru, she was a political ruler for whom falsehood and sophistry must be ordinary tools. An impression on the surface could not be swallowed whole...

Still, probably the gratitude was real.
Only, I could not believe it was the whole reason.

Something else made her keep Hikaru here. That seemed the reasonable conclusion.

Two possibilities came to mind.

One: she knew a way to dominate—control Hikaru, and could move her according to her own will.
...But even without deep consideration, that was nonsense.

Hikaru did not entrust the direction of her will to others. Still less “Silver Star.” By force or persuasion, another person manipulating her was surely impossible.

The relationship before my eyes looked nothing like that anyway. Chachamaru avoided interfering excessively. Precisely why Hikaru seemed to find this manor comfortable.

Then?

...The other possibility?

Without needing control or domination, Hikaru's presence served the Kubou's interests.

————Was that it?

ja.html:
……足利茶々丸もやはり、嘘を言っているようには
見えない。
　光と違い、虚言詭弁は常套手段であろう政治権力者
の事、上辺の印象を鵜呑みにはできないが……。

　おそらく、恩を受けたというのは真実。
　しかし、それのみとは考えられない。

　何か別に理由があって、光を留めている。
　そうみるのが妥当だ。

　咄嗟に思い付く理由は二つ。

　一つは、光を支配――制御する方法を心得ており、
自分の意のままに動かせるから。
　……しかしこれは深く検討するまでもなく<ruby>的外れ<rt>ナンセンス</rt></ruby>で
ある。

　己の意思の矛先を他人に委ねる光ではない。
〝銀星号〟なら尚更だ。実力をもってにせよ、口舌を
もってにせよ、他者が彼女を操るなど全く不可能な事
だろう。

　そもそも、いま目の当たりにしている両者の関係は
とてもそんな風には見えない。
　足利茶々丸は光に過度の干渉をせず、なればこそ、
光もこの館を過ごしやすいと感じているようだ。

　では？

　……もう一つの理由か？

　<ruby>支配制御などするまでもなく<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>、光の存在が堀越公方
の利益に適うから。

　――――なのか？

Hikaru"Who is on duty today?"



Chachamaru"Old Michiba."



Hikaru"That craftsman? Something to look forward to, then. I shall go."
